description: This file contains implementation of text editing features related to markdown shortcuts and marks in a Slate-based rich text editor, including applying marks, handling insertions, and managing inline formatting based on shortcuts.

methods.name: applyMark
methods.description: Applies a specified markdown mark to the selected text, adjusting the editor's history and removing the mark after application.

methods.name: withMarks
methods.description: Enhances the editor with markdown shortcut handling, inline mark management, and custom insert break behavior based on document features.

methods.name: getStartOfBlock
methods.description: Retrieves the starting point of the current block element in the editor.
